learning_goals.learning_goal: What would people change before trying the product?

findings.heading: Smaller starter pack
findings.content: One fictional participant wanted a smaller initial commitment.

findings.heading: Predictable delivery
findings.content: A second fictional participant needed a delivery window.

overall_takeaways: A smaller pack would lower the barrier to trying the product.

learning_goal_responses.summary: Wants a smaller starter pack before committing.
learning_goal_responses.quote: I would try a smaller pack before buying a full month.

learning_goal_responses.summary: Needs a delivery window they can plan around.
learning_goal_responses.quote: I need to know which day it will arrive.

evidence_coverage.text: Two fictional interviews; this is not a market estimate.

recommended_next_steps.title: Test a smaller starter pack
recommended_next_steps.rationale: One fictional participant wanted a smaller initial commitment.

references.message_text: I would try a smaller pack before buying a full month.
